data.body:
RP-06 design is operator-approved, including the final output-contract decision: persist the versioned per-unit discovery trace for retry/audit/diagnostics, but keep review and review-status responses limited to their established narrow end-result fields. The explicit `rebar review-plan --retry` override is also approved: only the literal latest completed INDETERMINATE review with retryable missing calls is eligible; content-identical pass/block successes are reused; only missing calls rerun; every explicit retry receives a fresh attempt budget; stale, changed, corrupt, legacy, or otherwise ineligible lineage refuses before any provider call; and the flag conflicts with --force/--status/--check while remaining compatible with --no-sign.

Created epic uneducated-habitual-primate (58bd-d656-c52f-4cf4), RP-06 — Unified effective-policy discovery for review gates, and decomposed it with the task-management agent skill into seven child stories:
- S1 dietetic-pompous-boar: immutable effective review-policy snapshots
- S2 unwhite-generous-wolverine: typed discovery execution and trace contracts
- S3 rookie-aeromarine-huia: code-review cutover
- S4 childproof-prominent-racerunner: plan-review cutover
- S5 sullen-famished-incatern: exact review-plan --retry and canonical documentation
- S6 illiterate-alkylic-solenodon: Authored Workflow versus read-only Effective Policy editor view
- S7 downcast-anaemic-civet: cross-gate shadow/live cutover guard

Dependency graph: S1 -> S2 -> {S3, S4}; S4 -> S5; S1 -> S6; {S3, S5, S6} -> S7. The graph was verified after updating the planning worktree to origin/main at 48d4a4d4a9; the intervening subprocess-environment test hardening does not change RP-06 scope. S5 explicitly requires documentation in native review-plan --help, generated docs/cli-reference.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, and docs/exit-codes.md, with a generated-help drift guard. Comparable RP-02/RP-05 decompositions support stopping at child stories for this approval; implementation-task decomposition can occur per story before its plan review.
